origin: One near-tie in the earlier 32-seed confirmation motivated the 0.5-logit cutoff. Those 32 seeds are development evidence for this new rule. Four router pilot seeds have appeared in earlier screening and four are new.
rule: The primary starts with edit neighborhoods plus drift. On a full-vocabulary top-two gap of at most 0.5 it reruns the complete packed request, discarding the first answer. No token identities, labels or separate comparator outputs enter this decision. The fixed-position comparator uses the same rule. Charge all first attempts, duplicate work, fallback and synchronization. Advance only if no reference-success target is lost, all controls survive and mean time ratios are at most 0.8 to two-row and below 1 to packed. Confirm if both upper paired 95% confidence limits satisfy the same speed thresholds and all answer criteria still hold. Never replace the primary with a comparator.
budget: Local Apple M5. No paid GPU.
